_memo:
Internal Memo — Nitrile Gloves Negotiation (2026-09-11)

No deal reached. Seller offered 150 units at $43/unit with free freight — price and quantity were acceptable to us — but held firm on a day-40 ship date and 30% upfront payment for new customers, both citing lack of authorization to deviate. We held firm on net-60 (non-negotiable company policy, no prepayment) and 30-day delivery. Seller could not get director approval during the conversation and declined the order rather than accept our terms. No agreement signed; nothing binding. Left open: if seller's director later approves net-60 and a day-30 (or day-40, negotiable) ship date, we should revisit — $43/unit and 150-unit first order remain acceptable on our end. Recommend logging as a lost opportunity for now and exploring alternate suppliers in parallel.
